We also cover AMD CEO Lisa Su joining the Council of Corruption with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang and others, plus her bootlicking of Howard Lutnick. In other news, Intel says there's no Core Ultra 290K Plus, AMD and Intel CPU prices are going up, and the Sony PS5 price has increased.
